Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zugeo 0.0.0.9000

  • zugeo_info() reports the bundled geoarrow-c and nanoarrow versions and the GeoArrow specification version implemented.

  • geo_type_of() describes a GeoArrow field from its Arrow schema: every GeoArrow 0.2 extension name, both coordinate layouts, list and large_list offsets and the view storage types, with layout errors for what the specification forbids.

  • geo_crs() carries a coordinate reference system exactly as given, typed as GeoArrow asks, and geo_crs_equal() compares two at three levels without PROJ.

  • geo_vctr holds geometries in the Arrow arrays they were read in, as positions, so subsetting, rev() and c() copy no buffer. With zugeo loaded, zuarrow reads every GeoArrow column as one and writes it back with its extension metadata unchanged; format() gives WKT.

  • geo_vctr() reads WKB, EWKB (its SRID becomes the CRS), hex WKB and WKT, checking every element, and geo_as_wkb(), geo_as_wkt() and geo_as_native() convert between encodings. Coordinates round-trip through WKT bit for bit: numbers print as the shortest text that reads back the same, through zufast.

  • geo_coords(), geo_from_coords() and geo_points() move coordinates to and from columns; geo_crs_text() gives the CRS as one string for sf and PROJ.

  • Converting to WKB or WKT is an error when it would drop a non-planar edge type from geometries with edges; lossy = "warn" or "allow" converts anyway. A null inside a geometry is a layout error when a column is read. geo_coords() carries the CRS and edges to geo_from_coords().

  • geo_box(), geo_box_all(), geo_types(), geo_dims() and geo_n_coords() compute over the coordinate buffers; boxes are geo_extent vectors with geo_extent_union(), geo_extent_intersection() and geo_extent_intersects().

  • geo_hilbert() and geo_sort() give flatbush’s Hilbert keys exactly, the same as DuckDB’s ST_Hilbert. geo_validate() reports unclosed or short rings, non-finite coordinates, mixed dimensions and winding.

  • geo_rtree() and geo_kdtree() build packed indexes in flatbush’s and kdbush’s formats, byte for byte, so geo_index_raw() bytes load in flatbush, kdbush and geo-index. geo_query_box(), geo_query_radius(), geo_query_nearest() and geo_join_box() query them; geo_join_box() descends two indexes together. geo_index_from_raw() checks bytes before use.

  • With qio 0.1.2, geo_read_parquet() and geo_write_parquet() read and write GeoParquet 2.0 and 1.1: WKB in the native GEOMETRY and GEOGRAPHY types with the geo key beside them, CRS and edges checked to agree, rows in Hilbert order, and bbox = skipping row groups by their statistics. geo_parquet_info() reads the footer alone, and geo_validate_parquet() reports what gpq validate checks, what GeoParquet 2.0 adds and the distribution guide’s advice.

Developed by Pedro Baltazar.
